Title: Purple Seduction Chemise
Content: Celebrating 10 years of creating super sexy lingerie Provocative have surprised us with the ultra-seductive Poupinette collection which is absolutely eccentric and created with the finest high-end materials with the most exceptional quality. If you're a lover of purple then this collection is definitely for you! Each Poupinette item comes packaged in an elaborate shiny pink 'Poupinette' branded box and an outer sleeve showcasing the product imagery. Instead of the normal oval shape at the sides for the sleeve this collection has inverted V-shapes making this rather distinctive. A Poupinette branded tag is also attached to each item with the product code size colour and barcode followed by washing instructions. Great for displaying in your shop! One further care label with 'Poupinette' written is also sewn into the product. Introducing the Purple Seduction chemise an extremely sexy creation comprised of contrasting sheer tulle and stretch lace. A sexy halter neck style invades the front of the chemise and is decorated with gorgeous stretch lace. This stretch lace follows onto the chest with an open bust area. Between the cups is a purple ribbon and and the underband is elasticated. The back of the neck is flirtatiously tied with two straps of elasticated fabric... the perfect way to untie the chemise in a romantic setting! Further at the back are two adjustable straps. The main body charmingly has a panel of darker coloured tulle with stunning imprinted floral patterning which looks amazing on the skin. The rest of the chemise is covered with plain sheer tulle. The hem is edged with elasticated straps allowing room at the legs and gives a mini dress kind of look. Included is a matching thong with sheer tulle which an underlayer of black fabric sits at the gusset to provide decency. A very soft to touch chemise. The Purple Seduction chemise comes packaged in a branded Poupinette box with an outer sleeve to showcase the product imagery. Also part of the Poupinette set is the Purple Seduction babydoll (PO6004) and body (PO6006).

Below this is an open oval design edged with ribboning. The bottom of the brief is also edged with ribboning. Title: Gabriella 473 Katherine Hold ups Natural/White/Blue
Content: Introducing the elegant Katherine from the new Gabriella collection 'In Love'. A feminine design embracing decorative sexy lace with a subtle pattern perfect to complement special occasions and the most important things in life. This design comes in Natural/White/Blue which predominantly the legs are covered in nude (natural) colour the strip is white and the lace is blue.  These thin delicate self-supporting hold ups contain two individual silicone strips inside the lace band; the silicone looks great on the naked skin and it prevents the slipping and wrinkling of the hold ups whilst worn. The finishing touch is the packaging; luxurious feel and touch with a representation of the product on the front branded with blue metallic 'in love' font. A further image is located on the back to show the back view when the hold ups are worn.
